hero.headline: Every team member can have its own Telegram bot
hero.sub: A member's menu now connects that member's own Telegram bot, with its name and photo.

shot.alt: A team member called Analyst in the orbit demo project. Its three-dot menu is open with three rows: Add a card, New session and Connect to Telegram.
shot.caption: A member's menu now has Connect to Telegram. It connects that member's own bot.

blocks.text: Telegram needs a bot you create yourself and connect in the Mac app. Nothing reaches Telegram until you do. Codex works; Antigravity stays in beta (docs/tool-parity.md lists what was seen in a real turn).

The rest since 0.41.9, such as the Super's own schedule, automation results on Telegram, one-by-one Telegram questions, the app approval card and readable report pages in dark mode, is in the changelog: those screens cannot be shown here.

closer.title: Get 0.41.13
closer.body: The app updates itself. New here? Download it from the latest GitHub release, or run npm i -g dreamcontext.
